name: Mombasa
blurb: Mombasa is an established port city and coastal destination in Kenya known for its historical sites like Fort Jesus and beach areas like Bamburi. Recent discussions highlight local infrastructure updates, including the SGR train and expanded port and transport services.

quotes.text: The heatwaves here have been *bad*. 35+ C. I lived in Nairobi which obviously is cool but even hot coastal spots I spent time in - Mombasa, Kinshasa, Dar el Salaam - generally were 30ish
